landing.text:
HEADLINE
Make informed decisions quickly

SUBHEADLINE
For executives and team leaders, extract key decisions and action items from lengthy meeting recordings.

WHAT THIS IS
A focused tool that helps executives and team leaders move from lengthy meeting recordings to make informed decisions quickly.

WHO IT IS FOR
Executives and team leaders

THE PROBLEM
Waste time reading through lengthy meeting recordings to identify key decisions and action items.

WHY EXISTING TOOLS FAIL
Manual note-taking or human summarizers were not designed for executives and team leaders, forcing workarounds that slow outcomes.

HOW IT WORKS
Provides actionable insights and ownership assignments, not just transcription.

KEY BENEFITS
Early users reach their first outcome without the overhead of general-purpose alternatives.

CALL TO ACTION
Start summarizing meetings
